headline: ‘Zoomsday’ hack uncovered using fewer than 20 AI prompts
summary: Zoom patched a major security vulnerability. An attacker could hijack devices during meetings. The flaw was discovered using under 20 AI prompts.

headline: Why your Amazon order confirmation emails have become so unhelpful
summary: Amazon order confirmation emails now list vague item categories. Specific product names are no longer displayed. Shoppers are frustrated by the lack of detail.

headline: GuliKit's new Switch controller features next-generation anti-drift thumbsticks
summary: GuliKit launched its ES Max wireless Switch controller. It boasts improved anti-drift TMR thumbsticks. Priced at $49.99, it's more affordable than Nintendo's Pro Controller.

headline: Bumble now lets men make the first move
summary: Dating app Bumble has changed its signature feature. Men can now initiate conversations in heterosexual matches. This reverses Bumble's long-standing women-first policy.

headline: Until Dawn Developer Supermassive Games Cutting Up to 75 Staff
summary: Supermassive Games, known for Until Dawn, announced layoffs. Up to 75 staff members will be impacted. This is the studio's third round of job cuts in three years.

headline: It's 2026 and People Are Arguing Over Sweaty Gears of War Movement Again
summary: Fans are debating Gears of War: E-Day movement. The discussion centers on 'sweaty' gameplay mechanics. This revives a familiar argument within the community.

headline: The Mad King: 9 Things We Learned About Westeros From the New Game of Thrones Play
summary: A new Game of Thrones stage play, 'The Mad King,' has opened. It reveals fresh details about Westeros. The production is rich with new GoT lore.

headline: Watchmen CGI Doesn't Hold Up, The Comedian Actor Jeffrey Dean Morgan Says
summary: Jeffrey Dean Morgan states Watchmen's CGI hasn't aged well. He believes the film's visual effects don't hold up today. However, Morgan is proud of his fight scene with Ozymandias.

headline: Summer 2026 on course to be UK's hottest on record, says Met Office
summary: The Met Office predicts Summer 2026 will be the UK's hottest ever. Only average August conditions are needed to break the record. The current record was set just last year.

headline: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
summary: Reports suggest Trump used a catering truck for a secret plane swap. This occurred during a NATO summit due to an Iran threat. Reporters were falsely told he was on Air Force One.

headline: Eclipse chasers scramble for glasses as stocks run low
summary: Specialist eclipse glasses are nearly sold out online. Demand surged ahead of the UK's upcoming significant eclipse. Many are scrambling to find protective eyewear.

headline: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
summary: Zelensky accuses Russia of using North Korean missiles in Ukraine. Strikes in Zaporizhzhia reportedly involved these ballistic missiles. Six were killed and 19 injured in the attacks.
